title: I Don’t Know Kung Fu (Part 2)
synopsis: How many people do you think actually practice traditional Chinese martial arts?

fullText.simplified:
对不起，我不会功夫（二）

    上回我们讲到了造成人们质疑武术真实性这一窘迫局面的三个原因，而这些原因导致了传统武术在当代的几大生存怪现状。
    最明显的就是招摇撞骗者多，真有看家本领的大师却并不热衷于抛头露面。这些所谓的大师往往是半吊子选手，武术的造诣不够，又想把武术作为敛财手段。因此他们会用现代散打、搏击中的招数糅合部分武术招式，吸引一知半解的人们，收取动辄数十万的拜师费。一旦遇上真正的高手他们就会找尽借口，贻笑大方。给人们留下了武术大师都是骗子的刻板印象。
    第二个怪现状就是真正潜心研究的人屈指可数。目前只有河南嵩山少林寺等少数系统性的门派了，而其他门派则需要花很大精力才能寻访到老师傅。
    最后一个怪现状就是不少人认为武术没有实战性，是花拳绣腿。这在很大程度上是对的，因为现代搏击就是在各国武术的基础上，加入了科学性的人体力学研究，从这一点上古不敌今是毫无疑问的。而另一方面，汉语中的武字本义就是“止戈为武”，因此武术最初存在的意义就是停止争端而不是主动发起进攻。因此真正的传统武术大师在能一击致命的招式的传授上是很谨慎的，如果不是纯粹的武术爱好者，而且经过长期的品性考验，是得不到师傅的倾囊相授的。
    发展到今天，我们与其把武术理解成高深的搏击技能，不如理解成和瑜伽一样的修身养性的传统艺术更合适。这门技艺就像一位蒙着层层面纱的姑娘一样，等待着被正视和探索。
fullText.traditional:
對不起，我不會功夫（二）

    上回我們講到了造成人們質疑武術真實性這一窘迫局面的三個原因，而這些原因導致了傳統武術在當代的幾大生存怪現狀。
    最明顯的就是招搖撞騙者多，真有看家本領的大師卻並不熱衷於拋頭露面。這些所謂的大師往往是半吊子選手，武術的造詣不夠，又想把武術作為斂財手段。因此他們會用現代散打、搏擊中的招數糅合部分武術招式，吸引一知半解的人們，收取動輒數十萬的拜師費。一旦遇上真正的高手他們就會找盡借口，貽笑大方。給人們留下了武術大師都是騙子的刻板印象。
    第二個怪現狀就是真正潛心研究的人屈指可數。目前只有河南嵩山少林寺等少數系統性的門派了，而其他門派則需要花很大精力才能尋訪到老師傅。
    最後一個怪現狀就是不少人認為武術沒有實戰性，是花拳繡腿。這在很大程度上是對的，因為現代搏擊就是在各國武術的基礎上，加入了科學性的人體力學研究，從這一點上古不敵今是毫無疑問的。而另一方面，漢語中的武字本義就是“止戈為武”，因此武術最初存在的意義就是停止爭端而不是主動發起進攻。因此真正的傳統武術大師在能一擊致命的招式的傳授上是很謹慎的，如果不是純粹的武術愛好者，而且經過長期的品性考驗，是得不到師傅的傾囊相授的。
    發展到今天，我們與其把武術理解成高深的搏擊技能，不如理解成和瑜伽一樣的修身養性的傳統藝術更合適。這門技藝就像一位蒙著層層面紗的姑娘一樣，等待著被正視和探索。

sentences.simplified: 上回我们讲到了造成人们质疑武术真实性这一窘迫局面的三个原因，
sentences.traditional: 上回我們講到了造成人們質疑武術真實性這一窘迫局面的三個原因，
sentences.pinyin: shàng huí wǒ men jiǎng dào le zào chéng rén men zhì yí wǔ shù zhēn shí xìng zhè yì jiǒng pò jú miàn de sān ge yuán yīn

sentences.simplified: 而这些原因导致了传统武术在当代的几大生存怪现状。
sentences.traditional: 而這些原因導致了傳統武術在當代的幾大生存怪現狀。
sentences.pinyin: ér zhè xiē yuán yīn dǎo zhì le chuán tǒng wǔ shù zài dāng dài de jǐ dà shēng cún guài xiàn zhuàng
sentences.english: Last time, we talked about the three reasons for the embarrassing situation causing people to question the authenticity of martial arts.
These reasons have caused several major strange phenomena of traditional martial arts in the present era.

sentences.simplified: 最明显的就是招摇撞骗者多，
sentences.traditional: 最明顯的就是招搖撞騙者多，
sentences.pinyin: zuì míng xiǎn de jiù shì zhāo yáo zhuàng piàn zhě duō

sentences.simplified: 真有看家本领的大师却并不热衷于抛头露面。
sentences.traditional: 真有看家本領的大師卻並不熱衷於拋頭露面。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn yǒu kān jiā běn lǐng de dà shī què bìng bú rè zhōng yú pāo tóu lòu miàn
sentences.english: What’s most obvious is that there are many showy swindlers, ..

sentences.simplified: 这些所谓的大师往往是半吊子选手，武术的造诣不够，
sentences.traditional: 這些所謂的大師往往是半吊子選手，武術的造詣不夠，
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē suǒ wèi de dà shī wǎng wǎng shì bàn diào zi xuǎn shǒu wǔ shù de zào yì bú gòu
sentences.english: .. while masters who really do have special skills aren’t fond of showing off in public.

sentences.simplified: 又想把武术作为敛财手段。
sentences.traditional: 又想把武術作為斂財手段。
sentences.pinyin: yòu xiǎng bǎ wǔ shù zuò wéi liǎn cái shǒu duàn
sentences.english: These so-called masters are often mere dabblers who lack attainments in martial arts, ..

sentences.simplified: 因此他们会用现代散打、搏击中的招数糅合部分武术招式，
sentences.traditional: 因此他們會用現代散打、搏擊中的招數糅合部分武術招式，
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ tā men huì yòng xiàn dài sǎn dǎ bó jī zhōng de zhāo shù róu hé bù fen wǔ shù zhāo shì
sentences.english: .. and see martial arts as a means of raking in money.

sentences.simplified: 吸引一知半解的人们，收取动辄数十万的拜师费。
sentences.traditional: 吸引一知半解的人們，收取動輒數十萬的拜師費。
sentences.pinyin: xī yǐn yì zhī bàn jiě de rén men shōu qǔ dòng zhé shù shí wàn de bài shī fèi
sentences.english: Consequently, they use moves from modern Chinese boxing and wrestling together with some styles from  martial arts ..

sentences.simplified: 一旦遇上真正的高手他们就会找尽借口，贻笑大方。
sentences.traditional: 一旦遇上真正的高手他們就會找盡借口，貽笑大方。
sentences.pinyin: yí dàn yù shàng zhēn zhèng de gāo shǒu tā men jiù huì zhǎo jìn jiè kǒu yí xiào dà fāng
sentences.english: .. to attract people with only a smattering of knowledge, and easily collect hundreds of thousands in apprenticeship fees.

sentences.simplified: 给人们留下了武术大师都是骗子的刻板印象。
sentences.traditional: 給人們留下了武術大師都是騙子的刻板印象。
sentences.pinyin: gěi rén men liú xià le wǔ shù dà shī dōu shì piàn zi de kè bǎn yìn xiàng
sentences.english: If they meet a genuine expert, they will look for any excuse and make fools of themselves.
It leaves people with the stereotype that martial arts masters are all tricksters.

sentences.simplified: 第二个怪现状就是真正潜心研究的人屈指可数。
sentences.traditional: 第二個怪現狀就是真正潛心研究的人屈指可數。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr ge guài xiàn zhuàng jiù shì zhēn zhèng qián xīn yán jiū de rén qū zhǐ kě shǔ

sentences.simplified: 目前只有河南嵩山少林寺等少数系统性的门派了，
sentences.traditional: 目前只有河南嵩山少林寺等少數系統性的門派了，
sentences.pinyin: mù qián zhǐ yǒu hé nán sōng shān shào lín sì děng shǎo shù xì tǒng xìng de mén pài le
sentences.english: The second strange thing is that you can count the people who genuinely study whole-heartedly on your fingers.

sentences.simplified: 而其他门派则需要花很大精力才能寻访到老师傅。
sentences.traditional: 而其他門派則需要花很大精力才能尋訪到老師傅。
sentences.pinyin: ér qí tā mén pài zé xū yào huā hěn dà jīng lì cái néng xún fǎng dào lǎo shī fu
sentences.english: Currently there are only a small number of systematic schools, like the Shaolin Temple on Mt Song in Henan.
Other schools have to spend large amounts of energy to be able to find a master.

sentences.simplified: 最后一个怪现状就是不少人认为武术没有实战性，
sentences.traditional: 最後一個怪現狀就是不少人認為武術沒有實戰性，
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu yí ge guài xiàn zhuàng jiù shì bù shǎo rén rèn wéi wǔ shù méi yǒu shí zhàn xìng

sentences.simplified: 是花拳绣腿。这在很大程度上是对的，
sentences.traditional: 是花拳繡腿。這在很大程度上是對的，
sentences.pinyin: shì huā quán xiù tuǐ zhè zài hěn dà chéng dù shang shì duì de
sentences.english: The last thing that makes it strange is that many people believe that martial arts isn’t actually combative.

sentences.simplified: 因为现代搏击就是在各国武术的基础上，
sentences.traditional: 因為現代搏擊就是在各國武術的基礎上，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi xiàn dài bó jī jiù shì zài gè guó wǔ shù de jī chǔ shang
sentences.english: It’s fancy, but impractical. To a very large extent, this is correct, ..

sentences.simplified: 加入了科学性的人体力学研究，
sentences.traditional: 加入了科學性的人體力學研究，
sentences.pinyin: jiā rù le kē xué xìng de rén tǐ lì xué yán jiū
sentences.english: .. because modern fighting is based on martial arts from all countries, ..

sentences.simplified: 从这一点上古不敌今是毫无疑问的。
sentences.traditional: 從這一點上古不敵今是毫無疑問的。
sentences.pinyin: cóng zhè yì diǎn shang gǔ bù dí jīn shì háo wú yí wèn de
sentences.english: .. mixed with the scientific research on human mechanics.

sentences.simplified: 而另一方面，汉语中的武字本义就是“止戈为武”，
sentences.traditional: 而另一方面，漢語中的武字本義就是“止戈為武”，
sentences.pinyin: ér lìng yì fāng miàn hàn yǔ zhōng de wǔ zì běn yì jiù shì zhǐ gē wèi wǔ
sentences.english: On this point, there’s absolutely no question that the ancient times are no match for the present.

sentences.simplified: 因此武术最初存在的意义就是停止争端而不是主动发起进攻。
sentences.traditional: 因此武術最初存在的意義就是停止爭端而不是主動發起進攻。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ wǔ shù zuì chū cún zài de yì yì jiù shì tíng zhǐ zhēng duān ér bú shì zhǔ dòng fā qǐ jìn gōng
sentences.english: But on the other hand, the original meaning of the character “wǔ” in Chinese is “to use force to maintain peace.”

sentences.simplified: 因此真正的传统武术大师在能一击致命的招式的传授上是很谨慎的，
sentences.traditional: 因此真正的傳統武術大師在能一擊致命的招式的傳授上是很謹慎的，
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ zhēn zhèng de chuán tǒng wǔ shù dà shī zài néng yì jī zhì mìng de zhāo shì de chuán shòu shang shì hěn jǐn shèn de
sentences.english: Consequently, the original reason for the existence of martial arts is to halt conflict, and not to initiate attacks.

sentences.simplified: 如果不是纯粹的武术爱好者，而且经过长期的品性考验，
sentences.traditional: 如果不是純粹的武術愛好者，而且經過長期的品性考驗，
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bú shì chún cuì de wǔ shù ài hào zhě ér qiě jīng guò cháng qī de pǐn xìng kǎo yàn
sentences.english: Consequently, genuine traditional martial arts masters are very cautious to teach lethal strikes.

sentences.simplified: 是得不到师傅的倾囊相授的。
sentences.traditional: 是得不到師傅的傾囊相授的。
sentences.pinyin: shì dé bú dào shī fu de qīng náng xiāng shòu de
sentences.english: If they’re not pure martial arts enthusiasts, and spend a long time with their moral character being put to the test, ..
.. they won’t get taught everything by their master.

sentences.simplified: 发展到今天，我们与其把武术理解成高深的搏击技能，
sentences.traditional: 發展到今天，我們與其把武術理解成高深的搏擊技能，
sentences.pinyin: fā zhǎn dào jīn tiān wǒ men yǔ qí bǎ wǔ shù lǐ jiě chéng gāo shēn de bó jī jì néng

sentences.simplified: 不如理解成和瑜伽一样的修身养性的传统艺术更合适。
sentences.traditional: 不如理解成和瑜伽一樣的修身養性的傳統藝術更合適。
sentences.pinyin: bù rú lǐ jiě chéng hé yú jiā yí yàng de xiū shēn yǎng xìng de chuán tǒng yì shù gèng hé shì
sentences.english: In its present development, rather than us understanding martial arts as a profound fighting skill, ..

sentences.simplified: 这门技艺就像一位蒙着层层面纱的姑娘一样，等待着被正视和探索。
sentences.traditional: 這門技藝就像一位蒙著層層面紗的姑娘一樣，等待著被正視和探索。
sentences.pinyin: zhè mén jì yì jiù xiàng yí wèi méng zhe céng céng miàn shā de gū niang yí yàng děng dài zhe bèi zhèng shì hé tàn suǒ
sentences.english: .. it would be more fitting to understand it as a traditional art to practice one’s spiritual cultivation, like yoga.
This art is just like a girl covered in a multitude of veils, waiting to be seen and explored.

raw.synopsis: How many people do you think actually practice traditional Chinese martial arts?
sentence_translations: I’m Sorry, I Don’t Know Kung Fu (Part 2)
Last time, we talked about the three reasons for the embarrassing situation causing people to question the authenticity of martial arts.
These reasons have caused several major strange phenomena of traditional martial arts in the present era.
What’s most obvious is that there are many showy swindlers, ..
.. while masters who really do have special skills aren’t fond of showing off in public.
These so-called masters are often mere dabblers who lack attainments in martial arts, ..
.. and see martial arts as a means of raking in money.
Consequently, they use moves from modern Chinese boxing and wrestling together with some styles from  martial arts ..
.. to attract people with only a smattering of knowledge, and easily collect hundreds of thousands in apprenticeship fees.
If they meet a genuine expert, they will look for any excuse and make fools of themselves.
It leaves people with the stereotype that martial arts masters are all tricksters.
The second strange thing is that you can count the people who genuinely study whole-heartedly on your fingers.
Currently there are only a small number of systematic schools, like the Shaolin Temple on Mt Song in Henan.
Other schools have to spend large amounts of energy to be able to find a master.
The last thing that makes it strange is that many people believe that martial arts isn’t actually combative.
It’s fancy, but impractical. To a very large extent, this is correct, ..
.. because modern fighting is based on martial arts from all countries, ..
.. mixed with the scientific research on human mechanics.
On this point, there’s absolutely no question that the ancient times are no match for the present.
But on the other hand, the original meaning of the character “wǔ” in Chinese is “to use force to maintain peace.”
Consequently, the original reason for the existence of martial arts is to halt conflict, and not to initiate attacks.
Consequently, genuine traditional martial arts masters are very cautious to teach lethal strikes.
If they’re not pure martial arts enthusiasts, and spend a long time with their moral character being put to the test, ..
.. they won’t get taught everything by their master.
In its present development, rather than us understanding martial arts as a profound fighting skill, ..
.. it would be more fitting to understand it as a traditional art to practice one’s spiritual cultivation, like yoga.
This art is just like a girl covered in a multitude of veils, waiting to be seen and explored.
